name: 97062 · Tualatin, OR
findings: ZIP 97062 (Tualatin) has 106 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 49 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97062 (Tualatin) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 7 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
